test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.

Music

P. connecting people

Q. serves as a universal language

R. across cultures and generations

S. and expressing shared emotions
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (2)** i.e. **QPSR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence starts with "Music serves as a universal language," which is correctly represented by part **(Q).**
 
• Following this, "connecting people" logically continues the idea, indicated by **(P).**
 
• **Next,** "across cultures and generations" expands on the connection mentioned, represented by **(S).**
 
• **Finally,** "and expressing shared emotions" concludes the sentence, indicated by **(R).**

Therefore, the correct answer is **QPSR.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (PSRQ):** This option starts with "connecting people serves as a universal language," which disrupts the logical flow of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3 (SPRQ):** This option begins with "across cultures and generations connecting people and expressing shared emotions," which creates a fragmented sentence.
 
• **Option 4 (PQSR):** This option starts with "connecting people across cultures and generations serves as a universal language," which alters the meaning of the sentence and does not follow proper grammatical structure.
